subject: Re-ran on ACKed schema: 101 job checks, third stable repro = short declared span
body:
Re-ran against the current tree after your schema/SRT ACK message: ABI PASS (160/64/1172/11496, regions@2120, variant_hash@36), TGP2 parser 156/156 PASS including the new reserved_view/domain/declared-combined/compare-flag rules, real Rust planner 38/38 PASS on TestFastMath/accumulateKernel, arch9 v9_pack golden now also compared (texture/sampler/plane words0..6 PASS), array 2-layer and sampler native255/Metal0 positives PASS, image Vk-view mismatch refused, compare-flag positive/negative PASS, SRT count wrapper PASS (base+low6=4, malformed cases refused). Current bridge hash 52f00fec... .

Third stable required repro (new, matches frontend_audit's declared-span concern): one-byte-short declared span is authorized. Case in n2mb_v2_job_test.c test_refusals: 16x16 RGBA8 sampled texture, row_stride64, levels1, descriptor TEGU_PIPELINE_D2_SPAN=1023, BO padded >=1024. Expected: refuse because the declared span cannot cover the 1024-byte level0 layout. Actual: n2mb_method(7) returns0, submits, and n2t packs a 1024-byte plane. Cause: dispatch_v2 bounds wire span only against BO size; n2t_texture_validate/pack receives backing_length=o->size-base_offset, not the declared span. Please pass the declared span (accounting for level offset) as the layout bound and require it to cover the exact subresource span. This is independent of yaml 'wire span one byte shorter than a valid layout within a larger BO' case.

Recap of the other two still current at 52f00fec: sampler_index=99 on a combined descriptor accepted (bridge never reads TEGU_PIPELINE_D2_SAMPLER_INDEX); nonzero wire swizzle 0x210 replaced by identity 0x688 because l.swizzle_valid is never set. Suite result now 101 job checks / 3 required failures / 0 pending; everything else green. Files/STATUS updated. No commit/device/native build.
